hook.line: No speech; on-screen text says the OGs fell in love with AEO through this song.
hook.visual: Selfie close-up of a young woman, phone tilting as she steps back, ceiling light behind; small white text 'The OGs fell in love with AEO from this song (Nazarene)'.

beats.what: Handheld close-up, she backs away from the phone as the song builds
Full-body framing in her room, starts miming and gesturing to the lyrics
Hands on head on the emotional line
Smiling, hands to chest on 'see me as I am'
Raises open hands, mouthing the chorus
Leans back into the phone to end the take

why_it_works: One continuous take (no cuts measured) of lip-sync and gestures lets the song carry the whole video
Caption asks which song made you discover the artist, which invites comments from fans
Song-led audio (music bed at -17.3 dB, near full loudness) taps an existing fan community
weaknesses: 'AEO' here is the artist Anendlessocean, not answer-engine optimisation, so it is off-topic for the study
First spoken word only at 8.56 s; the hook relies entirely on the song
Small on-screen text sits low and outside the safe area (measured outside_safe_share 1.0)
for_robert: Not a model for explainer reels; the only takeaway is ending the caption with a direct question to pull comments.
